title: Frozen Corpses
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Generic |image=Lapis Corpse.png }} '''Frozen Corpses''' are special entities found inside {{Zone|Glacite Mineshafts}} that can be interacted with to grant loot. They can be found in numerous positions, such as laying down, buried in ice, or buried in rock. == Spawning == '''Frozen Corpses''' can spawn in any [[Glacite Mineshafts|Glacite Mineshaft]]. Depending on the size, {{Green|1-3}} corpses will spawn: an additional '''Frozen Corpse''' can spawn in with [[Heart of the Mountain#Dead Man's Chest|{{AN|Dead Man's Chest}}]] ({{Green|+0.5}}-{{Green|25%}}) and {{Coll|Frozen Corpse Milestones 2}}-{{Coll|Frozen Corpse Milestones V}} ({{Green|+10}}-{{Green|20%}}), raising the maximum number of '''Frozen Corpses''' in a Glacite Mineshaft up to {{Green|4}}. == Types of Corpses == There are {{Green|4}} different kinds of '''Frozen Corpses''' that can generate in any given [[Glacite Mineshafts|Mineshaft]].
